purpose: Trace actual presentation, resize and object release without replacing rendering or retaining COM resources

location.kind: shared DXGISwapChain vtable in non-executable readable section

original: Each aligned vtable pointer must equal loaded owner base plus the exact method RVA; live method prologue must match; all sites validated before any write
replacement: Named swapRelease/swapPresent/swapResize/swapPresent1/swapResize1 callbacks; pointer CAS only; no code-byte replacement
abi: Unmodified Windows x64 COM method ABI including this, Present1 parameters, ResizeBuffers1 node/queue arrays, original return and GetLastError; no instruction relocation
activation: After successful exact-profile D3D11 creation and device identity checks; inherits experimental/SafeMode gates; suppressed by DisabledPatchIds; no loader-lock GPU work
lifetime: Shared vtable applies to all objects of this exact wrapper class; modules and immutable forwarding state remain pinned for process lifetime; no saved COM object pointers or references
recovery: On partial install failure restore acquired slots by owner-aware CAS in reverse order, retain state/modules for in-flight callbacks and later chains; fatal if non-conflict restoration fails. Normal removal uses process exit and next-launch patch disable
game_runtime: NOT RUN; exact shared table and callback invocation must be confirmed in the next Skyrim test
